title: Hardcoding gas costs should be avoided
summary: ## Severity  **Likelihood:** Medium, because changes to gas costs have happened before, but it is not certain that there will be changes that affect the protocol.  **Impact:** Low, because even though calculations will be wrong they can still be done off-chain  ## Description  The modifier `markCost` in `SimpleAdministrator` has some hard coded gas cost values like for example 21000 (the base cost of an EVM transaction).
